data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## TDD Requirement
Write a failing test for `write-cycle-ledger.sh`. The test must FAIL (RED) before the script is created.

## Test Approach
Given: a writable ARTIFACTS_DIR set via `WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR`, and a valid JSON payload
When: `bash write-cycle-ledger.sh --artifacts-dir "$ARTIFACTS_DIR" --payload '{"cycle":1,"findings_summary":{}}'` is invoked
Then: exit code 0; `$ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json` exists and contains the expected JSON content; concurrent invocations (via parallel subshells) do not corrupt the file

Failure modes to test:
- Missing ARTIFACTS_DIR that is not writable: exits 1 with error message
- Invalid JSON payload: exits 1 with error message
- Concurrent writes: the last write wins without corruption (atomic rename guarantee)

## Implementation Notes
Create `tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh`:
- `test_write_cycle_ledger_creates_file`: basic happy-path write
- `test_write_cycle_ledger_concurrent_safe`: spawn 3 parallel writes, assert file is valid JSON after all complete
- `test_write_cycle_ledger_missing_artifacts_dir_fails`: exits non-zero when artifacts dir cannot be created
- `test_write_cycle_ledger_invalid_json_fails`: exits non-zero when payload is not valid JSON

Use `mktemp -d` for all temp directories. Set `WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR` to the temp dir so `deps.sh`'s `get_artifacts_dir()` resolves to it.

The test file must fail initially because `write-cycle-ledger.sh` does not yet exist.

## RED Marker
Update `.test-index` with RED marker:
- Add new entry: `plugins/dso/scripts/write-cycle-ledger.sh: tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh [test_write_cycle_ledger_creates_file]`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test file `tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh` exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh
- [ ] Test contains `test_write_cycle_ledger_creates_file` function
  Verify: grep -q 'test_write_cycle_ledger_creates_file' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh
- [ ] Test contains `test_write_cycle_ledger_concurrent_safe` function
  Verify: grep -q 'test_write_cycle_ledger_concurrent_safe' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh
- [ ] Test currently FAILS (RED) — write-cycle-ledger.sh does not yet exist
  Verify: ! bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] `.test-index` entry added mapping write-cycle-ledger.sh to test file with RED marker
  Verify: grep 'write-cycle-ledger.sh' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index | grep -q '\[test_write_cycle_ledger_creates_file\]'
- [ ] Test uses mktemp for all temp paths (no hardcoded /tmp names)
  Verify: grep -q 'mktemp' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$($(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && bash -c "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$($(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && bash -c "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
